name: Libre
description: Mandarin and neroli brighten a creamy bloom of orange blossom and jasmine sambac, settling into a quiet base of musk and vanilla.

name: Shalimar
description: Floral notes and a flash of bergamot sit above iris, jasmine and rose, giving way to a dense, sweet base of vanilla, tonka bean and opoponax.

name: Oud Wood
description: Smooth woods and spice: cardamom and pink pepper open into patchouli, amber and oud, warmed by tonka bean.

name: Aventus
description: Sparkling lemon and blackcurrant open onto pineapple and jasmine, while birch and oakmoss give the base a smoky, earthy edge.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540
description: Jasmine and saffron open airy and golden, held together by cedarwood and an ambergris accord.

name: Santal 33
description: Australian sandalwood and cedarwood are spiced with cardamom and powdered by iris and violet, with papyrus giving a dry edge.

name: Gypsy Water
description: Woody and aromatic: bergamot, juniper, lemon and pepper, then incense, orris and pine needle over amber, sandalwood and vanilla.

name: Layton
description: An apple-and-lavender blend: bergamot and cardamom up top, violet and geranium in the middle, patchouli, vanilla and praline below.

name: J'adore
description: Ylang ylang, Damascus rose and jasmine form a rounded, creamy floral bouquet with a smooth finish.

name: Oud for Greatness
description: A dark, spiced oud: agarwood oil and oud with lavender, saffron, nutmeg and patchouli, softened by musk.

name: Angels' Share
description: Cognac and oak give a boozy opening, followed by cinnamon and a sweet, nutty base of tonka bean, sandalwood and praline.

name: Black Opium
description: Coffee and white flowers are drawn together by a soft, sweet vanilla.

name: Mitsouko
description: Citrus and jasmine turn to peach, ylang-ylang and rose, then spices, amber and cinnamon settle over vetiver and mossy oakmoss.

name: Portrait of a Lady
description: A lavish rose enriched with blackcurrant, raspberry and clove, then deepened by patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Tobacco Vanille
description: Rich and sweet: tobacco leaf and ginger with spice, tonka and cocoa, plus a dried-fruit accord.

name: Silver Mountain Water
description: Neroli and mandarin sparkle above cool green tea and blackcurrant bud, with a sea-air freshness and a smooth finish of sandalwood and musk.

name: English Pear & Freesia
description: Ripe pear leads to a delicate freesia heart, grounded by patchouli. Light, juicy and quietly earthy.

name: Aqua Universalis
description: Lemon and bergamot are bright and clean, set against a soft floral heart. A veil of musk makes the whole composition feel fresh and airy.

name: Another 13
description: Ambroxan and ambrette seeds create a skin-like glow, with jasmine and moss adding an earthy, floral edge.

name: Acqua di Giò
description: Marine freshness meets green mandarin and a leaf of sage, keeping the whole composition bright, herbal and lightly salted.

name: Bal d'Afrique
description: Fresh and floral-woody: buchu, marigold, bergamot and blackcurrant, then cyclamen, jasmine and violet, over tonka, cedarwood, musks and vetiver.

name: Delina
description: A rosy, fruity-floral built on lychee and rhubarb over damascena rose, resting on soft musks, cashmeran and vetiver.

name: Paradoxe
description: Neroli bud adds a green floral lift above a smooth, glowing mix of white amber and white musk.

name: Side Effect
description: A warm, boozy spice blend of cinnamon, rum, tobacco and saffron on sandalwood, with hedione adding a smooth, airy touch.

name: Love, Don't Be Shy
description: Neroli opens gently before rose and honeysuckle, leaving a sweet, warm trail of marshmallow and labdanum. Soft, creamy and floral.

name: Reflection Man
description: An elegant, herbal-floral classic: rosemary and petitgrain open to neroli, iris and jasmine, resting on vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood.

name: L'Heure Bleue
description: An airy ozonic note leads into powdery iris and soft vanilla, giving a hushed, dusky character.

name: Angel
description: Sweet praline and earthy patchouli sit under a bright flash of bergamot, giving a gourmand scent with a surprisingly fresh lift.

name: Musc Ravageur
description: A sensual, floral-free amber: bergamot, mandarin and lavender at the start, then a warm, musky heart of amber and vanilla that rests on sandalwood.

name: Black Orchid
description: A dark, truffled floral: black truffle and ylang ylang with orchid and plum, deepened by rum and patchouli.

name: Flowerbomb
description: A floral bouquet that opens with peony, moves to centifolia rose and settles on freesia and vanilla. Soft, sweet and ambery.

name: Green Irish Tweed
description: Lemon, verbena and galbanum give a cool green opening, with lavender and violet in the middle. Sandalwood and cedarwood settle into a fresh, mossy woodiness.

name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
description: Ambrette, salt and sage create a breezy, mineral calm. Herbal and musky, with the feel of a cool coastal walk.

name: Grand Soir
description: Deep and glowing, an amber built from cistus labdanum, benzoin and vanilla, resinous and sweet.

name: Twilly d'Hermès
description: Spicy ginger brightens a creamy tuberose heart, while sandalwood gives the whole a smooth, woody finish.

name: Mojave Ghost
description: Soft and musky: ambrette and naseberry open to magnolia, sandalwood and violet, finishing on cedarwood, musks and vetiver.

name: Vanilla 28
description: Vanilla orchid and brown sugar lead a deep, sweet blend with tonka absolute, amber woods and a soft layer of musk.

name: Replica By the Fireplace
description: A cosy, smoky winter scent. Pink pepper, orange flower and clove lead to chestnut, guaiac wood and cade, ending on vanilla, Peru balsam and cashmeran. Warm and sweet.

name: Pegasus
description: Soft and almondy: anise, bergamot and almond open to cypress, violet leaves and orange blossom, drying down to vanilla, sandalwood and ambrox.

name: L'Homme Prada
description: Powdery iris and neroli lend a creamy, floral softness, touched by the green freshness of geranium.

name: Arabians Tonka
description: Saffron and bergamot lead into rose and oud, settling on amber, tonka bean, leather and brown sugar. A sweet, smoky and warm oriental built on a soft musk base.

name: Dylan Blue
description: Bergamot, grapefruit and fig meet an aquatic accord, with pepper and violet leaf in the middle. Patchouli, musk, tonka bean and incense give a warm, spiced base.

name: Atomic Rose
description: A rich rose-and-vanilla scent: bergamot brightens Turkish and Bulgarian rose with jasmine, and hedione adds a luminous, airy shimmer.

name: Cedrat Boise
description: A fresh citrus-woody scent built on citrus and blackcurrant with cold spices, aquatic jasmine and patchouli leaves, drying down to leather, oakmoss and vanilla.

name: Donna Born in Roma
description: Jasmine sambac and vanilla are rounded by cashmeran, giving a sweet, creamy floral with a smooth woody backdrop.

name: Good Girl Gone Bad
description: A creamy floral built on orange blossom, rose, osmanthus and tuberose, with daffodil giving the base a soft, green finish.

name: Idôle
description: Bergamot, juicy pear and pink peppercorn open onto rose and jasmine, ending in white musk, vanilla, patchouli and cedarwood.

name: Hacivat
description: A citrus-chypre scent: bergamot, pineapple and grapefruit give a juicy opening, jasmine, patchouli and cedarwood form the heart, and clearwood, oakmoss and dry timberwood anchor it.

name: La Nuit de L'Homme
description: Anise, black pepper and bergamot lead to lavender and labdanum, finishing on vanilla, patchouli and vetiver.

name: Jicky
description: Fresh herbs open the scent, with bergamot, lavender and rosemary, and over time tonka bean, vanilla and opoponax add a sweet, warm depth.

name: Alien
description: Jasmine sambac turns creamy and radiant here, resting on a woody cashmeran core and a soft amber glow that lingers close to the skin.

name: Kirke
description: A sweet, fruity scent: passion fruit, peach, raspberry, blackcurrant and pear over lily of the valley, resting on heliotrope, sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and musk.

name: Carnal Flower
description: Melon and bergamot freshen a heavy, creamy heart of tuberose and jasmine, finished with a soft layer of musk.

name: Khamrah
description: A dessert-like spiced gourmand: cinnamon, nutmeg and bergamot lead into dates, praline and tuberose, then a long vanilla, tonka, myrrh and benzoin base.

name: Lost Cherry
description: A boozy cherry gourmand: black cherry and cherry syrup with bitter almond, rose, balsam and roasted tonka.

name: Club de Nuit Intense Man
description: A fresh fruity opening of apple, bergamot and blackcurrant leads to rose, birch and jasmine, with a smoky-musky base of ambergris and patchouli.

name: 212 VIP
description: Passion fruit and bergamot sparkle over gardenia and a boozy hint of rum, leaving benzoin and musk to warm the base.

name: Viking
description: Pink pepper, bergamot and lemon open sharply, then rose and spicy mint lead toward a deep base of sandalwood, vetiver, patchouli and lavandin.

name: 9 PM Night Out
description: A sweet, warm evening scent: dragon fruit, bergamot and cognac up front, cardamom, suede and toffee in the middle, then tonka, patchouli and woody-amber materials at the finish.

name: Peony & Blush Suede
description: Crisp apple and soft peony sit over a suede base. Fruity and floral, with a faint, smooth, soft-edged finish.

name: Oud Satin Mood
description: Violet and two kinds of rose open a velvety floral that settles on natural oud, benzoin, vanilla and amber.

name: Gentleman
description: Pepper and lavender open into powdery iris and resinous balsam of Peru, with patchouli and vanilla keeping the base warm.

name: Un Jardin sur le Nil
description: Green mango and lotus blossom bring a juicy, watery brightness, softened by smoky incense and sycamore wood.

name: Armani Code
description: Clean citrus from mandarin and bergamot meets a herbal edge of tarragon, keeping the mood cool and composed.

name: Blanche
description: A clean, soft floral: aldehydes and rose open to peony and violet, with musks and sandalwood underneath.

name: Nomade
description: A gentle fruit and flower composition: plum, freesia and a mossy, earthy base of oakmoss.

name: Bloom
description: Creamy and floral throughout, built around Rangoon creeper, tuberose and jasmine in a slow, rounded progression.

name: Herod
description: A smooth tobacco gourmand: cinnamon and pepper meet tobacco leaf, incense and osmanthus, softened by vanilla, musks and cedarwood.

name: Luna Rossa Carbon
description: Lavender and cypress keep it cool and green, with liquorice adding a faint, sweet edge.

name: Intense Cafe
description: Rose and coffee form the heart of this warm gourmand, framed by a floral opening. Amber, vanilla and white musk give it a creamy, roasted-sweet base.

name: Absolute Aphrodisiac
description: A warm, animalic floral: white flowers over amber, vanilla and musk, with a castoreum edge that adds a leathery, skin-like depth.

name: Uomo Born in Roma Intense
description: Vanilla is sharpened by lavandin and anchored in earthy vetiver, sweet yet herbal and dry.

name: Her
description: Dark berries of blackcurrant, blueberry and raspberry lead into violet and jasmine, then dry to powdery white woods, musk and amber.

name: Ani
description: Bergamot, blue ginger and pink pepper open into blackcurrant, Turkish rose and cardamom. A vanilla-led base of benzoin, ambergris, patchouli and sandalwood makes it warm, spicy and creamy.

name: Mon Paris
description: Juicy strawberry and pear lead into peony and orange blossom, then dry down to soft musk, patchouli and vanilla. Fruity, floral and creamy.

name: Lipstick Rose
description: Rose and iris in a powdery veil, with grapefruit and violet on top and raspberry adding a little fruit. Vanilla and musk soften the finish.

name: Yara
description: Soft, sweet and fruity-floral: orchid, heliotrope and tangerine up top, a creamy gourmand and tropical fruit heart, then vanilla, musk and sandalwood.

name: Soleil Blanc
description: A creamy, sun-warmed floral: bergamot and cardamom with pistachio, ylang ylang and benzoin, rounded by a coconut-like accord.

name: Bonbon
description: A sweet gourmand fragrance: mandarin at the top, orange blossom in the middle and a soft caramel base. Fruity and creamy, with a candy-like character.

name: Tam Dao
description: Rose, myrtle and cypress open green and fresh before creamy sandalwood and cedar, with rosewood, amber and white musk adding a gentle warmth.

name: Gentle Fluidity Gold
description: Juniper berries and nutmeg open dry and spicy, then coriander turns to a warm base of vanilla, musk and ambery woods.

name: L'Interdit
description: Orange blossom opens into creamy jasmine and tuberose, while vetiver and patchouli give the white flowers an earthy, shadowed edge. Rich, smooth and slightly dark.

name: Eau des Merveilles
description: Elemi and bitter orange give a bright, slightly salty start, and benzoin brings a warm, resinous sweetness.

name: Scandal
description: Honey and gardenia lend a rich, sweet floral tone, brightened by blood orange and grounded by an earthy patchouli.

name: Thé Noir 29
description: Fig and bay leaves add a green, fruity thread to black tea and bergamot, with cedarwood, vetiver and musk beneath.

name: Rose of No Man's Land
description: A dry, spicy rose: pink pepper and Turkish rose with raspberry blossom, settling into amber and papyrus.

name: Guilty
description: Mandora and pink pepper start bright and spiced, a lilac heart follows, and an earthy base of patchouli closes the scent.

name: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning
description: A soft linen-fresh floral. Pear, lily of the valley and aldehydes open, iris, rose and orange flower follow, and patchouli, ambrette seeds and white musks keep it clean and quiet.

name: Galloway
description: Fresh and peppery: lemon and elemi lead into cardamom and iris, then dry down to clean musks, ambrox and smoky cypriol.

name: Luna Rossa Ocean
description: Grapefruit brings a sharp citrus lift, then incense and vanilla follow in a warm, resinous and slightly sweet drydown.

name: Aqva Pour Homme
description: Mandarin brings a bright citrus lift to a green, herbal heart of santolina, finishing on clary sage.

name: Boss Bottled
description: Apple, bergamot and pepper meet cinnamon, nutmeg and cardamom, a warm, spiced progression that rests on vetiver and musk.

name: Black Aoud
description: A dark oud perfume lifted by lemon, mandarin and saffron, with rose and patchouli at the centre and leather, guaiac wood and sandalwood underneath. Smoky, spicy and bold.

name: Pour Homme
description: Citron, bergamot and neroli open bright, followed by geranium, clary sage and blue hyacinth, then cedar wood, mineral amber, tonka beans and musk.

name: Poison
description: Coriander flickers at the start, then a heavy tuberose heart sinks into a warm, resinous trail of opoponax.

name: Rehab
description: A fresh, clean aromatic woody: bergamot and lavender over cedarwood, patchouli and sandalwood, finished with hedione and musk.

name: Red Tobacco
description: A heavy, spicy tobacco scent: saffron, cinnamon, incense, nutmeg, peach, apple and oud open, with patchouli and jasmine beneath tobacco, amber, vetiver, vanilla and musk.

name: Explorer
description: A woody, leathery men's fragrance that opens with bergamot, pomarose and sage, moves through vetiver and leather, and settles into patchouli and ambery woods.

name: Voce Viva
description: Bergamot and orange blossom rise over vanilla, with crystal moss adding a cool, earthy edge to the sweetness.

name: Fan Your Flames
description: Coconut and rum open a short but rich pyramid, moving to tobacco and tonka bean before oakmoss and Chinese cedarwood. Boozy, sweet and smoky.

name: Gold Man
description: A classic rose-and-lily opening with jasmine, orris and myrrh in the heart, over an animalic, mossy base of ambergris, civet, sandalwood and patchouli.

name: Polo Blue
description: Bergamot, sea notes and cardamom feel airy and fresh, with iris and basil verbena in the middle and earthy vetiver and patchouli below.

name: Orion
description: A fresh fruity opening of bergamot, red currant, apple and pineapple leads into spice, birch and jasmine, then incense, amber, oud, musk and cedar.

name: Dans tes Bras
description: Violet drifts into a smooth, powdery heart of heliotrope and cashmeran, resting on sandalwood and clean white musk.

name: Asad
description: A dark, warm amber for men: black pepper, pineapple and tobacco on top, patchouli, coffee and iris in the middle, and vanilla, benzoin and labdanum below.

name: Neroli Portofino
description: Citrus, lavender and herbs form a bright coastal opening. Orange blossom, jasmine and neroli follow, ending in soft amber and ambrette. Creamy, floral and fresh.

name: Club de Nuit Milestone
description: A fresh, marine-leaning scent for men: bergamot, red fruits and sea tones, then violet and sandalwood, ending on vetiver, musk and ambroxan.

name: CH
description: Bergamot and grapefruit brighten a heart of rose and jasmine sambac. Patchouli and praline underneath add a gentle, sweet depth to the flowers.

name: Himalaya
description: Sandalwood, ambergris, cedarwood and musk warm a start of bergamot, grapefruit and lemon.

name: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme
description: Yuzu sparkles first, then cinnamon and nutmeg add warmth before a quiet base of sandalwood.

name: 9 PM Elixir
description: Nutmeg and cardamom warm the opening before lavandin and leather take over, closing in a resinous, softly sweet base of labdanum, patchouli and vanilla.

name: Kenzo Homme
description: A marine accord drifts over smoky leather and patchouli, creating a salty, earthy contrast.

name: Gentle Fluidity Silver
description: Juniper and coriander give a crisp, aromatic start, while nutmeg and a soft vanilla musk bring a rounded, woody warmth.

name: Toy Boy
description: A spicy-floral scent with bergamot, pink berries, elemi and nutmeg on top, rose, flax flower and magnolia in the heart, and a dry vetiver and ambery base.

name: Olympéa
description: Green mandarin, ginger lily and jasmine over a salty vanilla, with cashmere wood and ambergris giving a smooth, skin-warm base.

name: L'Air du Temps
description: Carnation and gardenia open creamy and spiced, with rose and jasmine at the heart. Sandalwood and iris end powdery and woody.

name: Super Cedar
description: Rose petals open softly before a long stretch of cedarwood, which fades into silky musk and earthy Haitian vetiver.

name: Utopia Vanilla Coco 21
description: Honeysuckle, pear blossom, lemon and coconut open into jasmine, gardenia and tuberose, drying to sandalwood, Bourbon vanilla, patchouli and soft musks.

name: Paradiso
description: Citrus, mandarin and bergamot are bright, with jasmine at the heart. Pine, cypress and laurel leaf give a green, resinous base.

name: Cool Water Woman
description: Pineapple, lemon, melon and blackcurrant are watery and juicy, with lily and jasmine in the heart. Musk, sandalwood, peach and vanilla soften the base.

name: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia
description: Juicy pear sits on creamy white gardenia, with brown sugar adding a sweet, soft glow.

name: Replica Beach Walk
description: A sunny beach scent: bergamot, pink pepper and lemon, then ylang ylang, heliotrope and coconut milk, over cedarwood, white musks and benzoin. Fresh, creamy and sun-warmed.

name: Percival
description: Fresh and aromatic: bergamot, mandarin and pink peppercorn lead to lavender, iris and cardamom over fir balsam, tonka and white musks.

name: Signorina
description: Rose and pink pepper meet blackcurrant buds, then jasmine and peony melt into patchouli, musk and a creamy pannacotta accord.

name: HUGO Man
description: Lavender, apple, mint and grapefruit make a crisp, green opening. Geranium, jasmine and sage follow, with cedarwood, fir balsam and patchouli beneath.

name: Red Aoud
description: Citrus and lavender open onto rose, violet and patchouli. The base turns sweet and deep, with vanilla, toffee, tonka, oud, musk and amber, for a rich, warm finish.

name: Riflesso
description: Crisp green apple, pink grapefruit and bergamot lead to geranium, violet leaves and lavender, then tonka bean and vetiver join a note of Italian leather.

name: Crystal Noir
description: Mandarin, pink pepper and blackcurrant lead to tuberose, lily of the valley and caramel. Sandalwood, amber, vanilla and orchid keep it sweet and warm.

name: Hypnotic Poison
description: Bitter almond and sambac jasmine wrap around a creamy vanilla, producing a sweet, warm and slightly nutty bloom.

name: Le Parfum
description: Orange blossom opens bright over jasmine and patchouli. Cedarwood and honey give a sweet, earthy warmth.

name: Paragon
description: A smoky, aromatic woody scent: bergamot, white sage and lavender over palo santo, black pepper, sandalwood and agarwood.

name: Weekend
description: Mignonette, mandarin and sage open green, then hyacinth, iris, peach blossom and nectarine. Cedarwood, musk and sandalwood add a soft, powdery base.

name: Moonlight in Heaven
description: Grapefruit and mango give a fruity, sunlit start, supported by the roasted sweetness of tonka beans.

name: Ô de Lancôme
description: Lemon, mandarin and bergamot sparkle with honeysuckle, then basil, rosemary and jasmine. Oakmoss, sandalwood and vetiver close it fresh and herbal.

name: Wūlóng Chá
description: A tea-centred fresh scent. Bergamot, orange, litsea and mandarin open, oolong tea and nutmeg form the heart, and musk with fig finishes it softly.

name: Honour Man
description: A peppery, aromatic woody scent: two peppers and nutmeg give it bite, geranium and elemi add a green lift, and patchouli, vetiver, cedar and tonka settle it down.

name: K by Dolce&Gabbana
description: Juniper, cardamom and blood orange are crisp and bracing, with geranium, fig and sage following. Cedarwood, cypriol, vetiver and patchouli ground it.

name: Habit Rouge
description: Bitter orange brightens a spiced neroli heart. Beneath, leather, vanilla and amber build a warm, resinous base with a hint of oud.

name: Angel Nova
description: Raspberry and rose give a juicy floral sweetness, anchored by akigalawood. Fruity, rosy and gently woody.

name: For Her
description: Orange blossom, osmanthus and rose meet peach, with a warm bed of musk, amber, vanilla and vetiver beneath.

name: Polo Red
description: Lemon, bergamot and juniper are crisp and herbal, with saffron, clary sage and lavender. Cedarwood, vetiver and vanilla finish it dry and warm.

name: Obsession
description: Mandarin and bergamot add freshness, lavender and myrrh bring a warm herbal heart, and musk, sandalwood and patchouli linger beneath.

name: Fakhar Black
description: Apple, bergamot and ginger freshen lavender, sage and juniper. Tonka bean, cedarwood and vetiver leave a herbal, warm finish.

name: Perfect
description: Rhubarb and daffodil give a green, slightly tart start that turns sweet and milky with almond milk, anchored by woody cashmeran.

name: Fucking Fabulous
description: Leathery and nutty-sweet: bitter almond, tonka and orris with cashmeran, leather and a herbal clary sage edge.

name: Spicebomb Extreme
description: Pepper and saffron give a dry, spicy heat, deepened by the resinous warmth of labdanum.

name: Club de Nuit Iconic
description: Grapefruit, lemon, mint and pink pepper sparkle, with ginger and nutmeg in the heart. Sandalwood, cedarwood, incense and amber make a warm, woody base.

name: Very Good Girl
description: Redcurrant and lychee give a tart, juicy opening, with rose in the middle and a base of vetiver and vanilla.

name: Orphéon
description: Juniper berry gives an aromatic edge to a floral jasmine heart, which dries to cedar and a sweet touch of tonka bean.

name: Nuit d'Issey
description: Grapefruit lifts a sweet heart of leather and vanilla. Patchouli and tonka bean make it smoky and warm.
